about: Every image used in Crown & Fable. Each entry must be public domain in the UK (artist died more than 70 years ago) and the US (published before 1931), and is credited in-game by artist, title, date and source. status: cleared = the specific image's rights page was checked; cleared-book = artist and book checked, specific file still to pick; to-confirm = not yet cleared, do not ship; open = no image chosen yet. size = pixel size of the downloaded file. crops = where to cut the image, keyed by card id (or 'board'); each rectangle is [x, y, width, height] as fractions of the image. window is the 17:10 art window, full is the 5:7 full-bleed card, board is the 16:10 battle backdrop. variant = the artwork's number for that card; the card's main artwork is number 1. tales = for a board, the tales whose Crown hero sets it.

images.notes: The best colour picture of him dancing by the fire. Commons and Bowling Green State University list it in Old, Old Fairy Tales (Whitman, USA, 1935), which could still be in US copyright. Wikipedia credits it to Collins' Grimm's Fairy Tales (1922), which would make it public domain in the US, but no scan of that book has been found to prove the plate is in it. Commons also gives the wrong death year (1930). Only 600 px wide.
